request.prompt: Identify every text-bearing label/panel in this product photo and report each as a tight bounding box in fractional image coordinates. Coordinates are 0..1, with (0,0) at the top-left and (1,1) at the bottom-right. Crop tight to the readable text — exclude bottle curvature/specular glare and surrounding shelf/hand/background. For each panel emit one entry with: kind (front_of_package | supplement_facts | ingredients | other_label | price_tag) and x_min_frac, y_min_frac, x_max_frac, y_max_frac.
